class.name: SteamServerDetailsOperation
class.brief_description: Cancellable observation of a direct Steam server details query.

method.name: is_finished
method.description: Return whether this query has a terminal result.

method.name: result
method.description: Return the terminal result, or null while pending.

method.name: wait
method.description: Await [signal completed] or read the existing typed result.

method.name: cancel
method.description: Cancel the native query before settling the observer with [constant ERR_SKIP]. A settled query returns [constant ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST].

signal.name: completed
signal.description: Emitted once after the native query has completed, failed, expired or been cancelled.
